title: The 1975 Cotton Club revue with Phil Moore
summary: Co-arranging the Cotton Club show with Phil Moore, Pete Meyers and Gil Laskey for a cast including Billy Daniels and the Nicholas Brothers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Okay. Duke Ellington, 'We Love You Madly,' Quincy Jones, we've talked about. Is there anything else you want to say besides what we've discussed for that show? I think we went into it pretty well.
Okay, because I don't remember what we said.
Cotton Club, '75, co-arranger with Phil Moore. I don't think we talked about that, did we?
Oh, no. Phil Moore. They had quite a cast on that, too.
Billy Daniels, Cleo Laine, the Nicholas Brothers -- who else? Gee.
I saw the show, but I can't remember.
Yeah. And I missed the show. We had a very good orchestra, you know?
And you and Phil Moore did the arranging.
Phil Moore and Pete Meyers and Gil Laskey.
You know? Because there was no way for any one man to cover that distance in that short a time, you know?
